description: Source code for the authentication store component of etcd, implementing user and role management, permission checks, token handling, and authentication enabling/disabling.

classes.name: AuthInfo
classes.description: Struct representing authenticated user information including username and revision.

classes.name: authStore
classes.description: Implementation of the AuthStore interface, managing authentication state, user/role data, permissions, and token handling.

methods.name: AuthEnable
methods.description: Enables authentication, verifying root user and role existence, and updating internal state.

methods.name: AuthDisable
methods.description: Disables authentication and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disables token provider if enabled.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication, returning a token if successful.

methods.name: CheckPassword
methods.description: Verifies a username and password pair, returning the revision if valid.

methods.name: Recover
methods.description: Recovers authentication state from backend, updating internal state and cache.

methods.name: UserAdd
methods.description: Adds a new user with specified options and password.

methods.name: UserDelete
methods.description: Deletes a user, disallowing deletion of root user if auth is enabled.

methods.name: UserChangePassword
methods.description: Changes password for a specified user.

methods.name: UserGrantRole
methods.description: Grants a role to a user.

methods.name: UserGet
methods.description: Retrieves user details including roles.

methods.name: UserList
methods.description: Lists all users.

methods.name: UserRevokeRole
methods.description: Revokes a role from a user.

methods.name: RoleGet
methods.description: Retrieves role details including permissions.

methods.name: RoleList
methods.description: Lists all roles.

methods.name: RoleRevokePermission
methods.description: Revokes a permission from a role.

methods.name: RoleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a role, disallowing deletion of root role if auth is enabled.

methods.name: RoleAdd
methods.description: Creates a new role.

methods.name: RoleGrantPermission
methods.description: Grants or updates a permission to a role.

methods.name: isOpPermitted
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission for a specific operation on a range.

methods.name: IsPutPermitted
methods.description: Checks if a user is permitted to perform a put operation.

methods.name: IsRangePermitted
methods.description: Checks if a user is permitted to perform a range read operation.

methods.name: IsDeleteRangePermitted
methods.description: Checks if a user is permitted to perform a delete-range operation.

methods.name: IsAdminPermitted
methods.description: Checks if a user has admin (root role) permission.

methods.name: NewAuthStore
methods.description: Factory function to create a new AuthStore instance.

methods.name: hasRootRole
methods.description: Checks if a user has the root role.
